The experts supported this: the topology auditor found a coherent mask for the chocolate (high confidence), but the perceptual auditor missed the textural anomalies because it focuses on noise/blur, not semantic realism. The geometric depth auditor confirmed general spatial consistency but cannot detect surface texture issues. I agree with the Router's severity assessments; the cherry artifact is moderate but distinct, while the chocolate itself is high-quality.
